items.title: First central moment in the even hyperelliptic ensemble with an explicit minimal-period-three secondary term
items.author: Hwanyup Jung
items.difficulty_reason: The complete moment asymptotic combines the completed central-value two-truncation identity, squarefree Poisson/Gauss sums, exact cancellation of principal contour pieces, square-dual Euler-factor analysis at the three cubic secondary poles and nonsquare dual bounds, proving both the explicit secondary coefficients and their minimal period three. Original fixed odd-prime-power q, genus limit and error quantifiers retained. Old K-poles lemma is only a singularity-analysis support step, not the entire first-moment theorem. Author numerical comparisons preserved without reexecution or independent certification.

primary.label: Complete original main first-moment asymptotic including both terms/error/minimal period

proof_spans.label: Complete original setup, zero/square/nonsquare dual contributions, contour/Euler-factor/secondary-period proof and final assembly
